verdict.rationale: Capacities documents an in-product AI assistant that answers from your notes. You can pass blocks or notes into AI chats as context, and the assistant can plan multi-step work and propose creates and updates for you to approve. Image analysis and property auto-fill add further suggestions inside the app. Missing for 10: evidence of proactive or unprompted insights surfaced from your data (auto-fill draws on the model's own knowledge, not your space), and independent or hands-on corroboration of how well the assistant works.
